headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 26, 2026**
article:
The Colorado Rockies secured a 5-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Tomoyuki Sugano earning the win after 5.1 innings of work. Brice Turang led the Brewers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with notable players including Josh Jung (Texas Rangers) and Juan Soto (New York Mets) being placed on the injured list due to left calf strains. Spencer Arrighetti (Houston Astros) has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right foot nerve irritation.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Kansas City Royals trading CF Kameron Misner to the Philadelphia Phillies for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired RHP Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres in exchange for Future Considerations. The Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Seth Halvorsen to the Los Angeles Dodgers for RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek.

top_news.title: **Rockies Take Down Brewers 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies secured a 5-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Tomoyuki Sugano earning the win after 5.1 innings of work. Brice Turang led the Brewers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Royals in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Kansas City Royals 2-1, securing their win behind a strong performance from Tarik Skubal. Skubal pitched 7.1 innings, striking out 12 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Cubs Edge Pirates in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-2, securing a narrow win. Pete Crow-Armstrong led the Cubs' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Take Down Nationals in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks edged out the Washington Nationals 3-2, securing a crucial win. Dylan Crews led the Nationals' offense with 2 hits, including a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Tigers in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 3-2. Impact players on both teams included Carter Jensen, Salvador Perez, Vinnie Pasquantino, Nick Loftin, Colt Keith, Riley Greene, and Hao-Yu Lee.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 5-3 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams and Tim Tawa contributing to the winning effort. Jacob Young also made an impact for the Diamondbacks in the loss.

top_news.title: **Jung Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers third baseman Josh Jung has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left calf strain, effective retroactive to July 22, 2026. Jung's injury will require a minimum 10-day recovery period.

top_news.title: **Royals Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals traded CF Kameron Misner to the Philadelphia Phillies for cash on July 25, 2026.
